The Special Committee on Government Investments
shall have the folloving duties and responsibilities:
a, To study, analyse, and determine the actual
Fincncial conditions and capital requirements
of government corporations end instrumentali-
ties and to recommend remedial measures neces-
sary therefor
b, To study and recommend appropriate policies
applicable uniformly to the different gene-
ral classes of government corporations and
instrumentalities;
c. To determine the propriety of disposing of
all or any part of the assets or stocks of
any government corporation or instrumentality,
and to formulate and recommend policies re-
lating to such disposition, including such
guidelines, safeguards and procedures as
shall be observed in the event of disposi-
tions, dissolution or liguidation;
d. Generally, to coordinate the investment po-
licies of all government finencial institu-
tions for the purposo of attaining maximum
use of available resources and particulariy,
to undertako periodic onalysis and review of
the investment portfolios of these financial
institutions with a view to sheping them into
an integrated annual pro ram of capital trans-

e. To study and recommond reorganization mea-
sures for government corporations and ins-
trumentalities in order to gear their ad-
ministrative machinery to the resuirements
of economic developaent, and
f. To recommend measured, both administrative
and legislative, designed to attain fully
the objective herein set forth.
The Presidential Iconomic Staff shall act as
the Secretariat of the Special Committee and shall
render the necessary staff support and technical
assistance.
The Special Comittee ard the Secretariat are
hereby authorised to secure date and information ad-
rectly from all government offices, agencies, cor-
porations, and entities and to consult with offi-
cials and personnel thereof, on matters roleted to
the above functions.
The officers and personnol of all goverment
offices, agencies, corporation and entities are
hereby enjoined to render full support and coope-
ration to the Speciel Committee and the Secreta-
rat in the discherge of their functions.
This Order shall take effect immedietely.
